scripts.build: bun run build:clean && bun run build:cjs && bun run build:esm && bun run build:core && bun run build:exports && bun run build:cli && bun run build:types
scripts.build:core: bun build src/core.ts --outfile dist/core.mjs --format esm --minify && bun build src/core.ts --outfile dist/core.cjs --format cjs --minify
scripts.build:exports: bun run build:themes && bun run build:theme-presets && bun run build:tokenizer && bun run build:renderer && bun run build:fast
scripts.build:themes: bun build src/themes/index.ts --outfile dist/themes/index.mjs --format esm --minify && bun build src/themes/index.ts --outfile dist/themes/index.cjs --format cjs --minify
scripts.build:theme-presets: bun build src/themes/presets/*.ts --outdir dist/themes/presets --entry-naming '[name].mjs' --format esm --minify && bun build src/themes/presets/*.ts --outdir dist/themes/presets --entry-naming '[name].cjs' --format cjs --minify
scripts.build:tokenizer: bun build src/tokenizer/index.ts --outfile dist/tokenizer/index.mjs --format esm --minify && bun build src/tokenizer/index.ts --outfile dist/tokenizer/index.cjs --format cjs --minify
scripts.build:renderer: bun build src/renderer/index.ts --outfile dist/renderer/index.mjs --format esm --minify && bun build src/renderer/index.ts --outfile dist/renderer/index.cjs --format cjs --minify
scripts.build:fast: bun build src/renderer/fast-mode.ts --outfile dist/renderer/fast-mode.mjs --format esm --minify && bun build src/renderer/fast-mode.ts --outfile dist/renderer/fast-mode.cjs --format cjs --minify
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/bin.ts --outfile dist/cli.js --format cjs --minify --target node
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test
